It’s officially May which means it’s Star Wars month! And what better way to celebrate than talking about The Mandalorian! With the upcoming movie releasing, I started looking a little closer at the armor and realized it's actually NOT as protective as it appears. It’s actually a DEATH trap, and if the Mandalorian is training Grogu to follow in his footsteps? Well, Grogu might be heading to an early grave…
